items.title: Q-040c dACC PE-weight delta correlation, config fix + pre-flight smoke gate (supersedes V3-EXQ-475b)
items.note: Successor to V3-EXQ-475b in the goal_pipeline:GAP-4 Tier-1 cohort. 475b FAILed at precondition P2 (dACC engagement): 0/6 seed-x-arm cells showed any dACC firing (n_dacc_fires=0 throughout, confirmed via REE_assembly/evidence/planning/failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-475b_2026-08-01.md). Root cause code-traced: ree_core/agent.py gates dACC's forward pass on `self.dacc is not None and z_harm_a is not None`; z_harm_a stayed structurally None because 475b's _build_arm_config called _lib.goal_pipeline_tier1.build_config(env, gap4_arm) WITHOUT enable_affective_harm_stream=True (default False; that flag is what wires use_harm_stream/use_affective_harm_stream/z_harm_a_dim into the config on the gap4_operating branch) -- the exact V3-EXQ-620/625 measurement-artifact footgun build_config's own docstring names by precedent. FIX (only substantive change from 475b): _build_arm_config now passes enable_affective_harm_stream=True; run_seed_arm also now stamps env._exq_env_kwargs explicitly (was previously coincidental via the module default) since that flag's branch reads limb_damage_enabled off it. Everything else -- P1 MECH-269b V_s-gating precondition, the Spearman-rho(|PE|, dACC bias-magnitude) correlation statistic, seeds 42/7/19, the 2-arm ARM_vs_off/ARM_vs_on structure, acceptance thresholds -- is unchanged. NEW: pre-flight smoke gate (autopsy learning #3) -- _preflight_dacc_engagement_check() runs a cheap pilot rollout (ARM_vs_on, seed 42, 3 warmup + 1 eval episode x 20 steps) BEFORE the full 3-seed x 2-arm design and raises PreflightDaccNotFiring (uncaught, fail-fast ERROR) if n_dacc_fires==0, so a structurally-dead dACC is caught in seconds rather than after the full ~90min budget. Verified both directions this session: with the fix, preflight measured n_dacc_fires=20/20 pilot steps and the full --dry-run's two cells measured n_dacc_fires=[48,48] (nonzero, confirms engagement); a monkeypatched negative control (forcing enable_affective_harm_stream=False, i.e. reproducing 475b's exact bug) correctly raised PreflightDaccNotFiring with n_dacc_fires=0. GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readout is the dACC bias-magnitude vs precision-weighted-PE correlation WITH dACC actually engaging. `reanalysis_query.py query --readout rho_pe_vs_bias_magnitude --claim Q-040` returns exactly one manifest (475b's own), whose n_dacc_fires=0 in every cell -- nothing to reanalyze. Not recoverable -> proceed to author. Re-derive brake (Step 2.5b): 0 prior substrate_ceiling autopsies tag claim_ids=["Q-040"] (checked via the skill's standard grep-count method over REE_assembly/evidence/planning/failure_autopsy_*.json) -- does not fire. 475b's own autopsy is a non_contributory driver-bug category (measurement/instrumentation), not substrate_ceiling, and is correctly excluded by that method. conditions=2 here (not 475b's original queue entry's conditions=6, which did not match its own seeds=3 x verdict-line count -- 475b's script never actually printed a verdict line at all, a latent progress-instrumentation gap; this version adds one verdict: PASS/FAIL print per seed-x-arm cell, so seeds(3) x conditions(2) = 6 total cells = 6 verdict lines, consistent). validate_experiments.py --strict --paths experiments/v3_exq_862_q040c_dacc_pe_weight_delta_correlation.py: OK, 0 findings across all 19 checks. --dry-run: both cells complete, verdict PASS x2, correctly self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue at the 1-seed smoke scale (P1/P2 both require >=2/3 seeds, matching 475b's own smoke-scale behaviour) -- expected, not a defect.

items.title: MECH-321 harm-aware selection: does SD-hazard-aware-policy-decomposition improve V3-EXQ-844's task-outcome statistic, at matched abort rates?
items.note: EVIDENCE successor to V3-EXQ-844 (confirmed failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-844_2026-08-01.md), which found MECH-321's mid-execution abort mechanism engages correctly (C2 mechanistic corroboration PASSED, +0.000247 forward-PE reduction) but does NOT reduce task harm (C1 load-bearing FAILED, -0.003262, wrong direction) using a paired post-divergence-window fresh-selection-restricted statistic. Code-verified root cause: the redecomposition step read no harm-valence signal and performed no ranked selection among candidate re-tilings at all. SD-hazard-aware-policy-decomposition (implemented 2026-08-01, ree-v3 a4a1b1d, chip-20260801-hazard-aware-decomp-build) closes that gap: PolicyDecomposition.harm_bias() (Stage 1, graded, always-active additive score_bias term) + .select_harm_aware_leaves() (Stage 2, categorical, threshold-gated pool-admission override), both default-OFF/bit-identical no-ops, gated by decomposition_use_harm_aware_selection (verified present on origin/main via git show origin/main:ree_core/agent.py). This run tests the exact follow-on named by both claims.yaml (MECH-321, 2026-08-01 entry) and the SD doc: does harm-aware selection improve V3-EXQ-844's C1 task-outcome statistic, ON vs OFF, at matched abort rates? ARM_SELECTION_OFF/ARM_SELECTION_ON hold 844's own manipulation (use_persistent_committed_program_handle, i.e. abort mechanism) FIXED ON in BOTH arms -- this is NOT a re-test of 844's own axis or of the refused 816e pre-commit/R1 env-harshening re-pose (re-derive brake check, Step 2.5b: 0 substrate_ceiling/non_contributory autopsy hits against MECH-321 at this granularity) -- and add decomposition_use_harm_aware_selection as the ONLY new manipulated variable, at the SD doc's / PolicyDecompositionConfig dataclass's / REEConfig.from_dims's default parameter values (verified identical across all three by direct source read; no documented reason to deviate). C1 STATISTIC REUSED VERBATIM from V3-EXQ-844 (_windowed_delta / _first_divergence_tick / _mean_at / fresh-selection-restricted split / EFFECT_SIZE_K_SIGMA=1.0 / REL_IMPROVEMENT_FLOOR=0.0 / MIN_DECOMPOSING_SEEDS=2), applied to ARM_SELECTION_OFF vs ARM_SELECTION_ON. MATCHED ABORT RATES (required design element, handled two ways): (a) per-seed decomp_n_decomposed_midexec counts and their ON-minus-OFF delta are recorded for every seed as a non-gating covariate (abort_rate_covariate); (b) the load-bearing C1 windowed comparison is restricted to seeds where BOTH arms independently decomposed mid-execution this run (both_decompose_seeds), so the measured delta reflects selection QUALITY among candidates the abort already produced, not whether an abort happened at all -- seeds where only one arm decomposed (on_only/off_only, an abort-rate-shift signature) are reported separately in unmatched_windowed_deltas, non-gating. New readiness precondition harm_bias_engages (ON arm only, existential: decomp_n_harm_bias_nonzero > 0) self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue rather than a C1 verdict if the treatment channel never engaged (z_harm_a never rose above harm_threat_floor this run). GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readout (paired matched-abort-pair windowed harm delta between harm-aware-selection ON/OFF) does not exist in any prior manifest -- confirmed via reanalysis_query.py query --readout decomposition_harm_bias --claim MECH-321 (0 of 4 matched manifests carry it, substrate built 2026-08-01) -- not recoverable, proceed to author. ARM_SELECTION_OFF cells ARE recoverable via arm-reuse from V3-EXQ-844's own reuse-eligible ARM_HANDLE_ON mint (verified: 844 manifest's ARM_HANDLE_ON rows carry arm_fingerprint.reuse_eligible=True, include_driver_script_in_hash=False, needed_keys all present) -- try_reuse_cell attempted per seed citing 844's run_id; a HIT (likely on a matching cloud machine-class) skips re-running that cell entirely, a REFUSE (e.g. machine-class mismatch) falls through to a fresh run, itself re-minted reuse-eligible. This means ARM_SELECTION_OFF's actual verdict-line count on the real run may be below its nominal 6 (reused cells print no verdict line) -- expected, not a bug; ARM_SELECTION_ON always runs fresh (6 verdict lines). estimated_minutes is calibrated against 844's OWN measured elapsed_seconds=22213.6 (~370 min, all 12 cells run fresh there) rather than 844's own originally-declared (and substantially wrong) 35-minute estimate, since this run's worst case (all reuse refused) is compute-equivalent to 844's. claim_ids=["MECH-321"] (matches 844's convention -- v3_pending stays true regardless of this run's outcome per the claims.yaml note; a single validation run does not clear the V3-pending gate on its own). bears_on = [MECH-321, SD-hazard-aware-policy-decomposition, ARC-070, ARC-071] (ARC-070 is MECH-321's parent claim; ARC-071 carried over from 844's own bears_on for chunk-composition symmetry). validate_experiments.py --strict --paths: OK, 0 findings (one config_slice-declaration advisory WARN resolved via CONFIG_SLICE_DECLARATION_EXEMPT -- the static resolver cannot trace the arm_id-conditional _config_slice() dispatch to the ON-arm branch; the harm-aware-selection constants ARE declared, under their REEConfig-mirror key names). --dry-run smoke: all 12 cells (2 arms x 6 seeds, 2 episodes x 12 steps) complete cleanly, manifest written and correctly relocated out of evidence/experiments/ (dry_run relocation confirmed), no crash; readiness correctly self-routes ARM_SELECTION_ON red / manipulation_inert_or_unmatched at this toy scale (harm_bias_engages precondition unmet -- expected, z_harm_a does not clear harm_threat_floor in 2 episodes; this is the smoke test working as intended, not a design defect).

items.title: MECH-025b precision-responsibility attribution, CORRECTED: residue-accumulation positive-control gate (supersedes V3-EXQ-671, degenerate -- eval loop never called update_residue)
items.note: Corrected retest of V3-EXQ-671 (MECH-025b precision-responsibility attribution), per failure_autopsy_batch9_2026-06-12's explicit recommendation ('Retest = V3-EXQ-671a: add a residue-accumulation positive-control gate'). Never actioned for ~7 weeks (checked: no such script/queue-id/git-history existed before this session). BLOCKER RE-CHECK (this session, code-verified, not assumed from the autopsy prose): ARC-016 is now status=stable (2026-07-25, V3-EXQ-818 PASS closed the eval-time structural gate) but the promotion is explicitly STRUCTURAL ONLY -- no harm DV; the ARC-029 behavioural-consequence layer stays separate. SD-003 (self-attribution via counterfactual E2) is still status=superseded (by MECH-256 / SD-029, 2026-04-18) -- unchanged since 671's original evidence_quality_note. Neither blocker's status change is load-bearing for this retest, because the actual root cause is NOT a substrate ceiling: ResidueField.accumulate() / REEAgent.update_residue() work correctly (300+ other scripts and StepHarness use them every waking tick) -- V3-EXQ-671's own eval loop simply never called update_residue() at all, so total_residue was mathematically pinned at 0.0 regardless of MECH-025b's truth value or ARC-016/SD-003's readiness. Two further script-side defects found and fixed in the same pass (same 'corrected implementation' scope): (a) is_committed was read from agent._committed_candidates (a multi-rate-clock candidate CACHE, non-None almost always) instead of SelectionResult.committed (the real BetaGate/E3 commit-threshold outcome -- the same field V3-EXQ-818 uses as its own commit_rate DV); (b) the eval sample filter pooled benefit ticks (harm_signal>0) in with harm ticks even though update_residue only ever accumulates on harm_signal<0. Also added owned= sourced from info['transition_type']=='agent_caused_hazard' (SD-003's own language for the ground-truth signal) so only agent-caused harm accrues responsibility residue, matching MECH-025b's own 'could have done otherwise' framing. POSITIVE-CONTROL GATE (the autopsy's actual request): a pre-registered P0 readiness check (experiments._metrics.p0_readiness_gate/P0NotReady) asserts sum(residue_delta_samples) > 1e-6 before C1/C2 are read; unmet -> FAIL / non_contributory / substrate_not_ready_requeue. A second net (experiments._metrics.check_degeneracy on the residue_delta_samples spread) catches a too-small/pinned sample even when the gate passes. VERIFIED (this session, not just designed): (1) --dry-run (5 warmup/2 eval/50 steps) shows total_residue_accumulated=0.34 (V3-EXQ-671 always showed exactly 0.0) -- the fix works; correctly self-routes to c1_residue_delta_degenerate_vacuous_test given only 1 sample at dry-run scale. (2) A monkeypatched-inert-case test (REEAgent.update_residue replaced with a no-op reproducing 671's exact defect) confirms the gate correctly self-routes FAIL/non_contributory/substrate_not_ready_requeue when residue genuinely never moves -- both branches of the gate verified, not just the happy path. (3) A medium-scale run (50 warmup/10 eval/200 steps, 99s) produced a clean non-degenerate FAIL (precision_does_not_modulate_residue_responsibility_weight, 3/6, C4 world_forward_r2=0.90 PASS, C5 harm_pred_std=0.015 PASS) rather than another vacuous 0.0/0.0 read -- confirming the fix changes the FAILURE MODE from instrument-defect to a genuine (if still under-sampled at this reduced scale) measurement. NOTED RISK: at this reduced scale only 2 committed+owned+harm samples occurred in 2000 eval steps (C3 needs >=20) -- because the corrected is_committed definition is much stricter (real BetaGate engagement) than 671's inflated 778-sample count (which was actually 'candidate cache populated', true almost always). This 50-warmup probe likely under-trains the precision-commitment circuit itself (ARC-016's own EXQ-018b needed full training for commit_rate to reach ~0.90 in a stable env), so it is not a reliable predictor of commit-rate at the full 500-warmup/50-eval budget queued here; if the full run again falls short of C3's floor, that is a legitimate (non-degenerate, gate-verified) undersampling finding calling for a budget-extension follow-up letter, not a repeat of 671's vacuous-instrument failure. validate_experiments.py --strict --paths: 0 findings. Supersedes V3-EXQ-671 (manifest already evidence_direction=non_contributory + non_degenerate=false; not re-tagged, per the same precedent as V3-EXQ-826/826a where the superseded original was left as-is).

items.title: INV-091: cross-stream similarity BAND falsifier, DYNAMIC-BUDGET null-validated re-run of V3-EXQ-828a (per-arm-per-seed pilot sizing, 3rd calibration attempt)
items.note: DYNAMIC-BUDGET (sizing-mechanism, NOT static-number) re-run of V3-EXQ-828a's design (THIRD calibration attempt for this driver family: 827/827a/828 hardcoded 1500 eval-phase steps -> 828a static-bumped to 3600 -> 828b dynamic per-arm-per-seed pilot). Same six-arm design, patches, DVs, thresholds (SIMILARITY_MOVE_FLOOR=0.02, COMPOSITE_MARGIN=0.15) as 828/828a. V3-EXQ-828 (weakens, 2026-07-29 governance, confirmed failure_autopsy_2026-07-28-sweep.json) and V3-EXQ-828a (weakens, confirmed failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-828a_2026-08-01, margin_vs_max=0.148 just 0.002 short of the 0.15 C2 threshold) both stay exactly as scored -- NOT retracted or superseded here. failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-828a_2026-08-01 (confirmed, status=confirmed) diagnosed 828a's own null_validation.checked=False as the SECOND consecutive miscalibration (worst cell needed 14,648 steps vs the 3600-step static budget supplied, ~4x short; tau_max AND period_max vary substantially by seed, and period_max -- not safety_factor*tau_max -- is often the BINDING term for a rare-firing stream) and routed to /implement-substrate: 'a per-run dynamic pilot pass that measures actual tau_max before committing to a fixed eval-phase budget'. That fix landed as experiments/_lib/inv091_driver_defaults.compute_dynamic_eval_budget() (ree-v3 ea9c52272d, substrate_queue.json INV091-NULL-VALIDATION-RUN-LENGTH now status=implemented/ready=true; REE_assembly 1bf64e4c95). This is the FIRST consumer of that function -- grep confirmed zero prior consumers before this script was written. GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readout is null_validation.checked computed against a PER-ARM-PER-SEED DYNAMICALLY SIZED eval-phase array -- never computed this way by any prior run (827/827a/828/828a all static); not recoverable by reanalysis. Proceeds to run. RE-DERIVE BRAKE (Step 2.5b): counted 1 substrate_ceiling/non_contributory-category autopsy target for INV-091 (failure_autopsy_2026-07-28-sweep.json), below the >=2 threshold -- brake does not fire (unchanged from 828a's own count). DESIGN: each of the six arms gets its OWN short pilot (INV091_PILOT_EPISODES=6 episodes) with that arm's OWN patch already attached (not just one shared per-seed intact-arm pilot) -- RATE_RANDOMIZED changes tick cadence directly (period_max is exactly what the autopsy found often binds) and MODE_DECORRELATED changes operating_mode's driving signal, so sizing those arms off an intact-arm pilot would risk the same failure via a different lever. The REAL pass then loops episodes until the recorded trace reaches the pilot-computed required_steps (capped at DYNAMIC_MAX_EVAL_EPISODES=400, ~60,000 steps at nominal length) rather than converting to a fixed episode count up front -- the module's own 'more robust still' recommendation, avoiding the exact nominal-episode-count conversion 828a's early-hazard-death terminations undercut. SMOKE (--dry-run, 2 warmup/2 pilot eps, 20 steps/ep, cap=10 real eval eps): all 6 arms x 3 seeds ran end-to-end with no crashes, verdict: PASS printed once per seed (3 total). The full pilot->compute_dynamic_eval_budget()->real-eval-loop call path was genuinely exercised (not stubbed) at toy scale: e.g. intact/seed=11 pilot saw 7 of 8 named streams go fresh (40 pilot steps), correctly flagged z_goal (1 fresh sample) and z_harm_a (saturated at the lag cap) as unreliable, applied the 1.5x unreliable-pilot multiplier (effective_multiplier=3.0 on a bare_plan_blocks_minimum of 320 steps = 960), and correctly fell back to the documented INV091_MIN_EVAL_STEPS_REQUIRED floor (2848, floor_applied=true) since 960 < 2848 -- a fully sane, well-structured, non-degenerate, auditable result, not a crash or a degenerate zero. All 18 cells hit the (expected, toy-scale-only) DYNAMIC_MAX_EVAL_EPISODES_DRY=10 real-episode cap (200 steps supplied vs a 2848-step requirement, honestly recorded as dynamic_budget_cap_hit=true rather than papered over) since 20-step dry episodes cannot reach a multi-thousand-step floor -- this is the documented, expected dry-run behaviour, not a defect; no PilotTooShortError fallback was ever triggered even at this toy scale (any_dry_run_pilot_fallback=false across all 18 cells). validate_experiments.py --strict: OK, 0 non-conforming (1 pre-existing advisory agent-seed-order WARNING, confirmed present identically in the 828a template -- not a regression). validate_recording.py --strict: OK, 0 always-core gaps, substrate_hash present. manifest carries null_validation_successor_of='V3-EXQ-828a' (informational cite, not supersedes -- none of 828/828a's evidence is invalidated) and complements=['V3-EXQ-827a','V3-EXQ-828', 'V3-EXQ-828a']. MINT: all six arms emitted reuse-eligible (include_driver_script_in_hash=False); fingerprints naturally distinct from 828a's (different eval_episodes_policy in config_slice), not a collision. estimated_minutes raised over 828a's 240 to account for the added per-arm pilot passes plus a real eval budget that can run well past 828a's fixed 3600 steps when a cell's measured tau/period genuinely demands it (up to the 400-episode/~60,000-step safety cap) -- a synthesis of INV-091's evidence must read this manifest ALONGSIDE V3-EXQ-827a's, V3-EXQ-828's and V3-EXQ-828a's, not in isolation.

items.title: MECH-166 wall-independent representation confirmer (slot_cosine_sim sole gate, ARC-065 noise-floor diversity fix)
items.note: IGW-20260801-223 (claim MECH-166, backlog EVB-0475, "Proposal for MECH-166") + IGW-20260801-225 (GOV-CONFIRM-1, "Confirm evidence: MECH-166, lit 0.88 exp ~0"). Prior draft (session 6ac06193-...-worktrees-best-practices-3e2efc, RELATIONSHIP.md + DESIGN.md) found these are the SAME evidence gap for MECH-166 (genuine_exp_count: 0 despite literature_confidence 0.876) -- one redesigned experiment discharges both, not two. Supersedes V3-EXQ-436 -> V3-EXQ-436a (both non_contributory, FAIL, conjunctive C1-AND-C2 gate). 436a's own evidence_direction_note diagnosed the root cause as a monomodal (bit-identical) waking policy starving the SWS-analog consolidation pass, and named the exact requeue condition: land ARC-065's behavioural-diversity substrate, then requeue as V3-EXQ-436b. ARC-065 is status:stable, v3_pending:False as of 2026-07-11 (claims.yaml, re-confirmed live 2026-08-01). (a) GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readout = slot_cosine_sim differentiation (SWS_THEN_REM vs WAKING_ONLY). reanalysis_query.py --readout slot_cosine_sim --claim MECH-166 found exactly one prior manifest (436a itself), flagged UNVERIFIABLE (no substrate_hash -- pre-recording-standard). Not recoverable by reanalysis -> proceed to author. (b) Substrate readiness (Step 2.5): ARC-065 (noise_floor.py, MECH-313) confirmed BUILT live at ree_core/policy/noise_floor.py + ree_core/utils/config.py:3238 (use_noise_floor default False, threaded via REEConfig.from_dims). MECH-313 itself is claim-status candidate/v3_pending:True but is a substrate DEPENDENCY here, not the claim under test (substrate built, evidence separate pattern) -- not a blocker. (c) Re-derive brake (Step 2.5b): MECH-166 0 braking autopsies, ARC-045 0, SD-017 1 -- all below the >=2 threshold. Brake does not fire. (d) LOAD-BEARING FIX FOUND DURING RE-VERIFICATION (this is what the draft flagged as an unconfirmed open item, and it was real): noise_floor.py's own docstring states its integration site is REEAgent.select_action() -> e3.select(temperature=effective_T) (confirmed live, agent.py:7438-7444). 436a's action-selection helpers (_select_action_baseline/_select_action_context_cond) never called select_action() -- they looped over discrete actions via agent.e2.world_forward + agent.e3.harm_eval and took a deterministic argmin. Simply setting use_noise_floor=True on the config while keeping that argmin path would have had ZERO effect on trajectory diversity (noise_floor constructed but never consulted), silently reproducing 436a's exact failure. FIXED: both action-selection functions now sample via softmax(-harms/effective_T) + torch.multinomial, using agent.noise_floor.compute_effective_temperature(...) -- the same computation the substrate's own select_action() performs, applied to this driver's own harm-based candidate scores. Verified in the --dry-run smoke: per-episode action-class entropy ~1.53 nats (close to ln(5)=1.609 uniform-over-5-actions), confirming genuine stochastic diversity is now live (vs the ~0 entropy the deterministic argmin would give). A defensive `assert agent.noise_floor is not None` guards against a future wiring regression. (e) DV primacy inverted per IGW-225's explicit mandate: slot_cosine_sim is now the SOLE PASS/FAIL gate (C1: slot_cosine_sim(SWS_THEN_REM) < slot_cosine_sim(WAKING_ONLY) in >=3/5 seeds -- directional per ARC-045's own pre-registered claims.yaml experimental implication, not the 436a bidirectional-diff shape, since ARC-045/SD-017/MECH-166 predict a specific sign). Behavioural metrics (harm_rate_*) and slot_separation (C4, ARC-045 secondary) are recorded but never gate. All three claim_ids share this one wall-independent test since claims.yaml's own notes for SD-017 and ARC-045 independently specify the identical cosine_sim comparison as their experimental implication. (f) DV-symmetry declaration (604c net, mandatory): the manipulation (ran SWS+REM consolidation vs not) directly mutates agent.e1.context_memory.memory via ContextMemory.write() during sleep, and slot_cosine_sim reads that same tensor -- not a broadcast constant, monotone rescale, or permutation, so the DV is not invariant under any of the flagged symmetry classes. (g) Scope: 436a's 3rd arm (SWS_ONLY) dropped -- not required for the primary MECH-166 question; the freed budget stays on the 2-condition (WAKING_ONLY, SWS_THEN_REM) x 5-seed comparison. Non-degeneracy self-report added (check_degeneracy over slot_cosine_sim + train_action_class_entropy_mean across all 10 cells) as a guard against a silent repeat of the original bit-identical-trajectory failure. label_balance added for the harm_eval_head training signal (436a did not record this). (h) Code review (Step 3.5): full checklist walked -- claim tagging, substrate API correctness (ContextMemory/REEAgent/CausalGridWorldV2/e2.world_forward/e3.harm_eval/noise_floor.py all independently grepped live before writing, confirmed unchanged), phased-training spirit preserved (harm_eval_head trains on .detach()ed z_world via its own optimizer, never backprops into E1/E2; unchanged from 436a), progress instrumentation ([train] ep N/M with M=training_episodes the loop bound, verdict PASS/FAIL x10 = 5 seeds x 2 conditions, Seed/Condition boundary lines), output contract (run_id _v3, architecture_epoch, outcome exact field, write_flat_manifest stamps recording core, z_goal_stream wired via ZGoalStreamAccumulator -- reports goal_state_present=False, correctly since this config does not construct a goal_state), runner conformance (emit_outcome at end of __main__ with args in module scope -- fixes a latent args-out-of-scope NameError bug present in 436a's own bottom block), arm_cell/arm_fingerprint used per cell (RNG-fully-reset guarantee, load-bearing now that action selection is stochastic; mint-as-you-go default, no reuse claim made). (i) Smoke test (--dry-run): both conditions x 1 seed complete cleanly, verdict PASS x2, manifest correctly relocated out of evidence/experiments/ to the scratch dir before the sentinel was written (confirmed via ls + sentinel manifest_path). (j) validate_experiments.py --strict: 0 findings across all 21 checks. Ethics preflight: all-false/allow (V3, no self-model, no suffering-like state).

items.title: MECH-292 goal-relevance ranking confirmer (representational, GOV-CONFIRM-1)
items.note: IGW-20260801-222 (GOV-CONFIRM-1, "Confirm evidence: MECH-292, lit 0.87 exp ~0"). claim_evidence.v1.json shows genuine_exp_count=0 despite a landed diagnostic PASS (V3-EXQ-496, 2026-04-27) because that run is experiment_purpose=diagnostic (module/wiring instrument check) and is correctly excluded from confidence scoring. This is the first experiment_purpose=evidence test of MECH-292's own scientific content: ghost_goal_bank.py module docstring pre-registers the exact falsifiable design ("paired comparison of a goal-relevant inactive anchor vs a goal-irrelevant inactive anchor with matched staleness, relevant should win in >=4/7 seeds, gap dominated by goal_match") -- this script implements that design directly. DV is representational/wall-independent (reads GhostGoalBankEntry.ghost_priority + .components off HippocampalModule.rank_ghost_goals() -- never touches action selection or reward), per the workset why_now; V3-EXQ-496 already proved this DV reachable, so no substrate_not_ready_requeue self-route was needed. Design: per seed, two agents built from the IDENTICAL torch.manual_seed (so cross-comparable z_goal embedding, the same trick V3-EXQ-496 UC4 already validates) but stepped through different env layouts under an identical goal-active schedule -- agent_B's own inactive anchors (ranked against its own final z_goal) are the goal-relevant candidates; agent_A's inactive anchors (ranked cross-agent against agent_B's z_goal) are the goal-irrelevant-but-real candidates. Identical schedules give matched AnchorSet tick/staleness progression without hand-rolled key merging. goal_cue_centering=True is a deliberate SD-079-motivated choice (verified wired end-to-end via AnchorSet.observe_goal_cue -> goal_cue_baseline -> Anchor.goal_match(baseline=...), reachable via REEConfig.from_dims -- not a silently-swallowed kwarg): the raw z_goal cone is too tight (min pairwise cosine ~0.988 per SD-079) for two genuinely different pursued directions to discriminate without it; the OFF-centering case is a known non-discriminating regime, not tested here as a second arm. NEW EXQ NUMBER not a letter of 496: 496 PASSED cleanly as a diagnostic/instrument check (not a bug fix target); this asks a different evidentiary question with a materially different single-mixed-relevance-pool design, matching the precedent already set by 496's own docstring ("behavioural validation ... lands in V3-EXQ-495", a new number, not a letter). GOV-REUSE-1: no reusable baseline fingerprint exists (496 is diagnostic-purpose, not baseline-purpose, not factored for reuse) -- fresh run needed. Re-derive brake: 0 prior autopsies tag MECH-292 -- brake does not apply. Non-degeneracy: self-routes non_contributory (never weakens) if fewer than 4/7 seeds produce a comparable pair. Dry-run smoke (2 seeds, 20 ticks) PASS: comparable=2/2, wins=2/2, goal_match_dominant=2/2, z_goal_stream active_frac=1.000 no writer defect.

items.title: MECH-267 mode-conditioning content-persistence confirmer (representational, GOV-CONFIRM-1)
items.note: IGW-20260801-223 (GOV-CONFIRM-1, "Confirm evidence: MECH-267, lit 0.87 exp ~0"). claim_evidence.v1.json confirms genuine_exp_count=0/experimental_confidence=0.0 despite two landed diagnostic PASSes (V3-EXQ-462 EXP-0158 rule binding, V3-EXQ-465 EXP-0161 intrusive simulation filtering, both 2026-04-21, both experiment_purpose=diagnostic substrate-wiring checks -- correctly excluded from confidence scoring). This is the first experiment_purpose=evidence test of MECH-267's own scientific content. Read ree_core/hippocampal/module.py end to end: operating_mode is consumed in exactly one place (_compute_mode_noise_scale), a scalar multiplied into the CEM proposal ao_std; ao_mean (candidate centre) never varies by mode, so the implemented mechanism can only ever differentiate proposal SPREAD, not content-identity -- the claim's replay-past-successful and stability-check content predictions are out of scope (no memory/history lookup or distinct offline_consolidation code path exists; deferred to EXP-0155 cue_action_proj [still blocked, V3-EXQ-449 confirmed zero-gradient consumer collapse] and an unbuilt forced-replay injection hook -- neither exists in ree-v3/ or REE_assembly/ outside the 462/465 notes). 462/465's own UC3-5 read ao_std directly at num_cem_iterations=1; propose_trajectories() REFITS ao_std from the elite pool's own empirical spread every iteration thereafter, and HippocampalConfig's production default is num_cem_iterations=3 -- so whether the mode-conditioned wiring survives to the FINAL returned candidate set (what E3 actually receives) was untested. DV is representational/wall-independent (per the workset why_now): reads action_object_decoder_raw_output_stats.std_by_action_dim off HippocampalModule.get_last_propose_diagnostics() directly -- no env, no REEAgent, no cue_action_proj, no forced-replay hook needed, so no substrate_not_ready_requeue self-route was required. Design: 30 seeds x 4 modes (external_task/internal_planning/internal_replay/offline_consolidation, matching claims.yaml's own four modes) x 2 iteration-count conditions (iters=1 manipulation check replicating 462/465's setting; iters=3 production-default load-bearing test), same terrain-prior weights + z_world/z_self held fixed within a seed across all 8 cells. Primary DV picked over discrete first-action entropy after a 30-seed pilot showed entropy saturates near ceiling at the top of the predicted order (internal_planning vs external_task mean gap -0.009 nats, noise); the continuous decoder-output-spread DV does not saturate (30/30 seeds full predicted ordering at iters=1, gaps 0.055/0.092/0.031, each >3 stdev from zero). Local 30-seed run for calibration (manifest NOT committed -- this queue entry is the official run): C0 manipulation check PASS (wiring reproduces at content level, robust); C1 production load-bearing FAIL (mean gaps -0.0003/+0.0035/-0.0037, all within noise) -> outcome FAIL/weakens -- the mode-conditioning content effect is real but is washed out by CEM's own multi-iteration elite-refit before reaching the candidates E3 actually sees. This is expected to reproduce deterministically on the runner (all seeds fixed, no training). Re-derive brake: 0 prior autopsies tag MECH-267 -- brake does not apply. GOV-REUSE-1: no reusable manifest exists (462/465 are diagnostic-purpose num_cem_iterations=1 only; the iters=3 production-default readout was never recorded) -- fresh run needed. validate_experiments.py --strict: OK, 0 warnings.

items.title: MECH-135 discriminative pair (E1_COE vs FROZEN z_world), StepHarness-invariant re-run of V3-EXQ-108
items.note: StepHarness-invariant re-run of V3-EXQ-108 (MECH-135 discriminative pair: does letting z_world co-evolve (E1_COE) during trajectory-scoring rollouts, vs freezing it (FROZEN), improve real-environment plan selection). Motivated by claims.yaml MECH-135's evidence_quality_note (tag multi_sense_audit_2026_05_08), which flags that V3-EXQ-108's _train_agent() called agent.sense() TWICE per env step (latent_prev before the action, latent_next after), doubling the substrate-tick rate during training vs eval's single-sense cadence -- exactly the failure mode experiments/_harness.py's StepHarness class exists to make structurally impossible (its own docstring names it verbatim). GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readout = real-env prox_delta (E1_COE vs FROZEN) from a StepHarness-invariant (single-sense-per-step) trained agent. Checked experiment_queue.json, runner_status.json, ree-v3/experiments/ directory listing, git log -S '108a' / 'stepharness' -- no prior 108-family StepHarness port or re-run exists anywhere. Not recoverable -> proceed to author. Re-derive brake (Step 2.5b): no failure_autopsy artifact tags MECH-135 (0 count) -- brake does not apply. PORTING APPROACH (see script module docstring for full rationale): only Phase 0 (_train_agent) carried the confound; Phases 1-6 (goal template, warmup state, candidate generation, FROZEN/E1_COE scoring, real-env execution) already sense() once per step and are byte-identical to V3-EXQ-108, since they replay externally-specified action sequences StepHarness's own on-policy select_action cannot reproduce. _train_agent is restructured to call sense() exactly once per step, pairing (latent,action) from step N with step N+1's sense() result to form the (s_t,a_t,s_t+1) triple the bespoke E1/E2 single-step MSE losses need (the same one-step-behind accumulation StepHarness's own module docstring recommends for warmup-with-aux-losses callers). The literal StepHarness class is deliberately NOT instantiated for training: its internal _e1_tick (multi-rate-scheduled inside generate_trajectories) calls agent.e1's forward pass and mutates agent.e1._hidden_state (confirmed stateful LSTM, ree_core/predictors/e1_deep.py), which would contend with this script's own per-step direct agent.e1(...) calls -- reintroducing an uncontrolled multi-rate substrate-advancement hazard (the same failure class, just relocated from sense() to E1's hidden state) unless the losses were also switched to agent.compute_prediction_loss()'s save/restore pattern (a materially different multi-step-window loss formulation used by V3-EXQ-514g, which would change more than the audited confound). 108's bespoke losses and its original uniform-random training-exploration policy are otherwise UNCHANGED, so this stays a narrow bug-fix-tier iteration per CLAUDE.md's EXQ Versioning policy (letter suffix, not a new EXQ number) -- precedented by V3-EXQ-514d->514g's own StepHarness port under the same convention. PRODUCTION SCALE (seeds [42,123], 100 train episodes, 200 steps/ep, 40 candidate sequences, horizon 30, warmup 20, goal_max_steps 2000, c1_threshold=0.05, c3_var_threshold=0.002 -- the script's own non-smoke defaults), not smoke-test scale. SEPARATE FINDING surfaced while re-reading 108's evidence (recorded here for the audit trail; NOT fixed by this entry -- claims.yaml is governance-only-edit territory): claims.yaml's MECH-135 note counts 108's 12:50:04Z run as a 'PASS ... second support entry', but that run is verifiably a --smoke-test run (n_train_episodes=2, thresholds relaxed to c1=-99.0/c3=0.0 -- matches the smoke-test override branch exactly), i.e. a vacuous test-mode pass, not real evidence. Meanwhile 108's SAME-DAY full-production-scale run (19:53:41Z, 100 episodes/200 steps/40 sequences/horizon 30/seeds [42,123], real thresholds) actually FAILED (c1_val=0.00229 << 0.05; c3 variance ~1.4e-14 << 0.002) -- but claims.yaml describes this run as having 'empty metrics -- runner artifact' and dismisses it, which does not match the manifest's actual (complete, non-empty) content. Flagged for governance review, not corrected here. Code review (Step 3.5): validate_experiments.py --strict clean (0 findings) after adding a check_degeneracy self-report (e1coe_score_var, prox_delta across seeds) and an AGENT_SEED_ORDER_EXEMPT citing V3-EXQ-108's own prior triage (agent_seed_order_lint_backlog_triage.md row 9 -- FROZEN/E1_COE scored off the literal same agent object within a seed, so unseeded weight init cannot confound the within-seed arm comparison). claim_ids=['MECH-135'] verified accurate (same mechanism under test as V3-EXQ-108). experiment_purpose='evidence'. Output contract (run_id _v3 suffix, architecture_epoch, outcome field, write_flat_manifest stamping recording-standard core) verified via dry-run manifest inspection. Smoke test (--dry-run): PASS, single seed, completes all 6 phases cleanly in ~1.6s, manifest correctly relocated out of evidence/experiments/ to the dry-run scratch dir (verified via find), sentinel written. [smoke] z_goal_stream: NOT RECORDED -- expected and unchanged from V3-EXQ-108: this script manually injects z_goal via direct GoalState._z_goal assignment (Phase 1) rather than the normal agent.update_z_goal() writer path, symmetrically across both arms, exactly as V3-EXQ-108 did -- not a new hazard introduced by this port.

items.title: ARC-062/MECH-309 full-budget replication of V3-EXQ-859: lateral_pfc route_source vs none ablation, MECH-448/449 engagement (~7.7h)
items.note: ARC-062/MECH-309 FULL-TRAINING-BUDGET replication of V3-EXQ-859's lateral_pfc-vs-none route_source ablation (failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-859_2026-08-01.md, user-confirmed routing: "chip the full-training-budget (~7.7h) replication now ... rather than deferring the compute-cost judgment call to /governance"). BACKGROUND: V3-EXQ-851 (full ~7.7h, P0=200/P1=90/P2=60, seeds 42/43/44) found MECH-448 (F-eligibility demotion) completely dead (0.0) under modulatory_channel_route_source='lateral_pfc', vs robustly live (17.76) under 'cand_world_summary' in matched-stack template V3-EXQ-654j (same seeds). MECH-449 was dead in BOTH arms, matching its deadness in 851. Two readings remained undistinguished: (a) route_source has no causal effect on MECH-448 at all -- 851's diagnosis needs a different explanation; or (b) route_source's effect is training-duration-dependent and only emerges over a longer run, which 859's 45-minute probe cannot detect by construction.
